LESSON: ANIMALS RESOURCES

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment and 1. 4 Plants By the end of the sub-strand, the  In a nature walk
Topic 1.5: Animals resources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Animals resources. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. categorize different animals in the environment
2. appreciate different animals in the environment. harmful, large/small) papiermache, clay or plasticine to model different animals. different animals.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. categorize different animals in the environment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to categorize different animals in the environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate different animals in the environment. harmful, large/small) papiermache, clay or plasticine to model different animals. different animals.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Animals resources.
2. Explain Animals resources to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: In groups, learners use environment? papiermache, clay or plasticine to model different animals.
4. Show that you can: categorize different animals in the environment
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Animals resources. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Animals resources important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In groups, learners use environment? papiermache, clay or plasticine to model different animals.
2. Learners sing song related to different animals.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

2. appreciate different animals in the environment. harmful, large/small) papiermache, clay or plasticine to model different animals. different animals.
